'''Blaze bugs''' were crimson insects used by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]] to represent battle images; specifically used in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Capable of glowing and darkening at the commands of a [[yammosk]], blaze bugs would provide visual representations of both Yuuzhan Vong and enemy vessels. Subtle differences in the coloration, sound, and even scent of the blaze bugs could tell the Yuuzhan Vong commander the disposition and effectiveness of the various vessels they represented. They were often used in conjunction with [[cognition throne]]s. Their bodies were hot to the touch, and when not being used, would descend upon nearby Yuuzhan Vong to suck their blood with stinging proboscises.
